Allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. Application accordingly disposed of.

3. The present Appeal has been filed under Section 415(2) of the BNSS, 2023 against the Judgement dated 06.05.2024 vide which the Petitioner has been convicted under Section 354 A IPC, Section 10 of the POCSO, Section 376 AB read with Section 511 IPC and Section 18 POCSO ACT and has been sentenced to imprisonment of 10 years RI.
4. Learned APP for the State appears on advance Notice.
5. The Notice of the Appeal be served upon the Prosecutrix through the IO for the next date of hearing.
6. The e-Trial Court record be summoned from the Trial Court.
